## Personality

Odette Pullen is an unassuming, hardworking, and dutiful individual who earns top marks in domestic science and possesses great culinary skills. Characterized by a steady, sensible, and pragmatic nature, she maintains a notable composure that makes her appear completely unshakeable. She is regarded as lady-like, pleasant, and unpretentious, maintaining a gentle disposition and a tranquil, rosy-faced nature that remains unsoured despite marital arguments. Though she finds teaching tedious, she initially intends to dedicate her life to pedagogy and forgo marriage forever. She later surrenders her position at the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school with plans to travel West during the autumn.

## History

Before starting her teaching career, Odette Pullen secured a school teaching position in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge), having previously spent four weeks tearfully reacting to the departure of the former schoolmaster, Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md). During a romantic theatrical play of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), she was cast as Guinevere, and on a separate occasion, her brother saved her sash just as she nearly tumbled into the [Lake of Glassy Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-glassy-waters) while reaching for water lilies. Later, Odette arrived with her brother [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) to escort friends to a charity concert at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), where they shared supper and enjoyed the evening together. Before beginning her upcoming teaching term, she joined [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) to discuss their differing views on classroom discipline. On a spring Saturday, Odette spent the day exploring [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and an abandoned garden alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and Isolde. As a member of a local delegation from the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), she accompanied [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to confront [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) over his plans for commercial advertising on his fence. Later, on New Year's Eve, Odette proposed marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md), but reacted with cool indifference when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejected the offer. Her successful work in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge) earned her a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor before she eventually made plans to move West. She later visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to offer her well-wishes to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) ahead of Nell's upcoming wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), +35 more_

## Quotes

> "yet I am certain I would be unable to remain motionless. Every minute or two, I would be sitting up to check my position and ensure I was not floating away too much. And Nell, you are aware that such actions would ruin the impression."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

> "Would it not be lovely if a person could have three wishes fulfilled . . . or perhaps just one? What wish would you make, girls, if a wish were granted to you? My wish would be for wealth, beauty, and intelligence."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “I formerly believed that a marriage would come about between you and Hugh,” Mrs. Gorham remarked. “If you are not cautious, Nell, every one of your suitors will slip away from you.”
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v3 ch.Weddings P31](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0031)

> "The main thing will be to keep order and a teacher has to be a little cross to do that. If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)

> "I’ll give my pupils a whipping whenever they misbehave. That is the most direct and simple method to persuade them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

Odette is the sister of [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md). On New Year's Eve, she proposed marriage to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother, but after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declined, Odette reacted with cool indifference and remarked that he would likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead. [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) later went on to marry, while Odette made plans to move West.
